comment: Derived-file rules for the auto-resolver's deterministic pre-pass. A file listed in a rule's `owns` is GENERATED, so a merge conflict in it is never a question for a human or a model — the answer is to merge the sources and re-run the generator. .github/scripts/resolve-generated.mjs reads this file; auto-resolve/prepare.sh uses it to route generated conflicts away from the LLM, and to defer the ones whose sources also conflicted until after those sources are resolved. Ships EMPTY: a rule that names a tool the repo does not have would fail a repo that never asked for it. Add your own — the two commented examples below are the common ones.

schema.command: argv array to run, from the repo root. Exactly one of `command` or `generator`.
schema.generator: path to a script to run. `interpreter` (argv array) defaults to ["node"].
schema.sources: exact paths whose change requires re-running this rule.
schema.sourcesPattern: optional regex (string) matched against changed paths, in addition to `sources`.
schema.owns: exact paths this rule GENERATES. A conflict in one of these is resolved by regenerating, never by editing.
schema.ownsPrefix: optional path prefix, ending in '/', whose whole subtree this rule generates.
